integrity: The full face set and boundary ranks are reconstructed from definitions by an embedded standalone verifier; face counts are cross-checked through an independent forest/root enumeration and ranks through column/transposed-row elimination.
scientific_limitations: Only reduced homology over F_2 for one graph is determined. No integral, torsion, homotopy-type, minimality, or family-wide claim is made. A plausible Cayley-graph thesis could not be inspected in full and remains an originality risk.
title: Mod-\(2\) homology of the triangular-prism Morse complex
